high_snr_regression_definition: SNR 4 or 6 dB, at least one previously correct user becomes wrong; includes net ties and net improvements
phase_diagnostics_scope: Evaluator-only truth; truly active users; frames q=1..Q-1; q=0 excluded
nmse_aggregation: 10*log10(sum(full channel squared errors)/sum(active true channel energy))
aer_aggregation: (total misses + total false alarms)/total user decisions
verification_scope: Saved-array re-scoring and hash/coverage verification; no independent inference replay
limitations: Known-phase receiver is an oracle phase comparator.
Historical research scenes are not claimed to be an untouched independent validation set.
Partial results reflect execution order and are not representative of the full population.
The six SNR observations of a physical scene are not six independent physical scenes.
Elapsed times are operational records, not an exclusive hardware-controlled speed benchmark.
Finite outputs at MAX_ITERATIONS are retained; convergence is reported separately.
No statistical significance, equivalence, global optimum, or performance acceptance is claimed.
